VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the details are not valid. Check the form and try again.
MALFORMED_JSON: That request could not be read. Try again.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That is too large to send.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
CONFLICT: That conflicts with something that already exists.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: We could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match an account.
AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
AUTH_SESSION_REVOKED: This session was signed out. Sign in again.
AUTH_INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Your session could not be renewed. Sign in again.
AUTH_REFRESH_REUSED: Your session was ended for security reasons. Sign in again.
AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is disabled. Contact support.
AUTH_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Confirm your email address before signing in. Check your inbox for the link, or ask for a new one.
AUTH_CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID: That is not your current password.
AUTH_IMPERSONATION_REFUSED: That cannot be done while impersonating this account. The account holder has to do it themselves.
AUTH_FEDERATED_SIGNUP_CLOSED: New accounts cannot be created here right now. If you already have an account, sign in with your email and password.
AUTH_FEDERATED_LINK_REQUIRED: Google can't confirm this email address for us. Sign in with your password, or create an account with one, then link Google from your account's security settings.
CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: That request could not be verified. Try again.
USER_EMAIL_TAKEN: That email address is already in use.
STAFF_EMAIL_TAKEN: That email address is already in use.
ORGANIZATION_LAST_OWNER: An organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
ORGANIZATION_PERSONAL_UNDELETABLE: Your personal organization is removed with your account.
ORGANIZATION_PERSONAL_CLOSED: A personal organization has one member — its owner. Create a team to work with other people.
ORGANIZATION_INVITATION_PENDING: That address already has an invitation waiting. Revoke it first to send another.
ORGANIZATION_INVITATION_ADDRESS_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that address to accept it.
